source_packet.source_table: Quarter-ended unaudited GAAP statements and separate company-defined non-GAAP/free-cash-flow reconciliation; fiscal Q4 versus fiscal Q3

rows.source_label: Net cash provided by operating activities

limitations: The June and September 2025 calendar quarter ends are fiscal Q3 and fiscal Q4, respectively. Quarterly first-column values were selected instead of the adjacent nine-month and full-year columns or guidance tables.

Scores, software, and professional-services revenue all declined sequentially. September GAAP operating expenses include a reported USD 10.922 million restructuring charge, but the June source packet has no corresponding charge row; no audited June zero or charge delta is asserted.
GAAP net income, company-defined non-GAAP net income, and company-defined free cash flow all declined; their accounting bases and reconciliation components are distinct.
Cash-flow figures are taken from the quarterly free-cash-flow reconciliation table, not from year-to-date cash-flow columns.
Selected rows do not audit score pricing, customer concentration, credit-model performance, full cash-flow statement, annual guidance, or every footnote.

reviews.rationale: Sequential comparison of selected SEC exhibit rows shows a broad softening across the displayed GAAP revenue components and total revenue, with GAAP operating income, pretax income and net income all lower on the later quarter, and company-defined non-GAAP net income lower as well. Operating cash flow and company-defined free cash flow also declined sequentially. The expense picture is mixed rather than uniformly adverse: cost of revenues and research and development rose while selling, general and administrative expense fell, and a restructuring charge appears only in the later selected rows with no baseline comparator, so its contribution to the operating-income change cannot be isolated from this extract. Because the selected rows are quarterly exhibit extracts rather than complete filings, and because no year-over-year, guidance, segment-mix, bookings or backlog evidence is present, the sequential softness cannot be separated from seasonality, timing, or one-off items.
